12042|e653c173.name: Loganaar
12042|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

181-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-progress.text: Were you able to convince Zzarc'Vul to lend us his monocle for our experiment?
181-progress.title: Look to the Stars

223-progress.name: Jonathan Carevin
223-progress.text: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
223-progress.title: Worgen in the Woods

293-progress.name: Archbishop Benedictus
293-progress.text: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
293-progress.title: Cleansing the Eye

322-progress.name: Grimand Elmore
322-progress.text: How might I ply my craft for you, $c?
322-progress.title: Blessed Arm

325-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
325-progress.text: Hello, $N.  You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.
325-progress.title: Armed and Ready

335-progress.name: Zardeth of the Black Claw
335-progress.text: Wishock will soon garner enough support to cause us much grief.  Were you able to obtain the Tear of Tilloa or Musquash Root yet?
335-progress.title: A Noble Brew

336-progress.name: Lord Baurles K. Wishock
336-progress.text:
Can you not see that I am busy?  My words must be heard!  I am very important to the future of this Kingdom!

Oh... what have you there?  Why it looks like a refreshing drink...
336-progress.title: A Noble Brew

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

98223-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-complete.text:
It's best we destroy this. Useful or not, we're not in the business of taking chances with any of those foul orcs.

The last thing we need are dragonriders on our doorstep!

And this Shadow Council business... most troubling. I'll send word to my superiors at once.
98223-complete.title: Old Habits

98230-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98230-accept.text:
After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
98230-accept.title: This Land Was Their Land

98230-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98230-complete.text: If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.
98230-complete.title: This Land Was Their Land

98291-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98291-complete.text: You won't catch me mournin' their ilk. They deserve their fate.
98291-complete.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

98293-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98293-complete.text:
Well done! Very well done!

We can definitely put these to use in replenishing our men. Half of these are from our own soldiers to begin with.

Fewer weapons in the hands of the enemy and more in ours is my kind of math, $c.
98293-complete.title: Forced Disarmament

98297-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98297-accept.text:
I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
98297-accept.title: Stopping the Cycle
